request_without_reference_paths.prompt: Design ONE original Coordination Court for the SAME knowledge-city civilization as the reference Memory Archive. Use the actual reference for material roles, architectural craft and generous eaves, NOT to duplicate its tower or tiered silhouette. A beautiful compact HORIZONTAL civic ensemble: three substantial connected wings in a U around a broad deliberately OPEN courtyard, facing the camera. A wide low central meeting hall joins two shorter side wings. A single broad circular stone council table is integrated in the courtyard paving, with no tiny chairs. Warm pale limestone walls, broad closed dark slate roofs, restrained aged copper roof edges and structural joints, a tiny warm amber entrance accent. Sculpted stepped foundations and generous crisp roof overhangs give refined proportions. The courtyard is intentional negative space visible from above, NOT a damaged roof; all hall roofs are closed and continuous. Window details are shallow framed rectangular recessed panels, never holes. Read clearly as gathering and coordination, not a palace, temple, castle, library, workshop or observation tower. No towers, domes, lens, chimneys, banners, gears, religious symbols, thin columns, thin bridges or railings. Strong memorable silhouette readable at elevated strategy-game map scale. Show the complete standalone ensemble in one elevated three-quarter isometric view, open U facing the viewer, all edges inside frame, plain neutral background with transparent cutout. No exterior ground tile or scenery, people, text, logos, floating parts, excessive grime, photorealism or dramatic baked lighting. Match the reference's warm handcrafted stylized finish, with elegant large material regions rather than noisy microdetail.

request.text_style_prompt: Original knowledge-city coordination court, a low U-shaped civic ensemble. Warm pale limestone walls, stepped plinth, entrance stairs, courtyard paving and round council table. Dark slate ceramic hipped roofs on all three wings. Aged copper roof edges, eave brackets, posts and wall framing with restrained verdigris. Recessed window panels and the arched rear door in deep aged copper-bronze, not bare wood. One tiny warm amber light above the rear door. The open courtyard floor stays pale paved stone. Broad calm hand-crafted stylized material regions readable from an elevated strategy-game camera, subtle stone variation, restrained weathering. Preserve the geometry. No text, logos, grime, baked lighting or baked shadows. Limestone matte, slate moderately rough, copper metallic.
